points.quote: `blocksuite/affine/` is the Affine editor built on that framework.
`store`: the document model, backed by Yjs (a CRDT library). Docs are trees of blocks.
`std`: the standard runtime. It covers block views, selection, commands, the extension system and the canvas/gfx runtime.
**`widgets/`**: floating UI such as the drag handle... **`fragments/`**: side panels such as outline, frame-panel, doc-title and adapter-panel.
BlockSuite imports nothing from outside itself. ... 442 files outside `blocksuite/` import it directly.
